provenance.pair_construction: derived: remove exact human-annotated emotional-reaction spans from the same response
provenance.limitations: Narrow emotional-acknowledgment ablation; removed versions are not human-rated low-empathy responses. Ablation can harm grammar. No inference of general empathy or mental-health capability.
provenance.split_policy: 80/20 shuffled connected groups from training/source corpus only; shared source/target texts and available document/context IDs never cross splits; benchmarks untouched
provenance.attribution: Sharma, Miner, Atkins & Althoff (2020), University of Washington
